product.name: Monoprice ABS Back Enclosure (Pair) for PID 4103 6.5in Ceiling Speaker (Will not work for PIDs 4102 or 4104)
product.description: Improve the sound quality of your in-ceiling speakers using these In-Ceiling Back Enclosure from Monoprice!This flame-resistant ABS enclosure is designed for use with the Monoprice 6-1/2 inch Fiber 2-Way In-Ceiling Speakers (PID 4103) or other speakers with the same dimensions. Using an enclosure improves bass response and the overall sound quality will be tighter and more focused.The enclosure has pre-stripped and tinned wires inside for connecting to the speaker. On the outside it features 10mm push terminals to connect the speaker wires from the amp. It measures 8.0" in diameter and is 5.1" deep.
